name: Toho Co., Ltd.
summary: Toho Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the film business in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Film Business, IP and Anime Business, Theatrical Business, Real Estate Business, and Other segments. The company is involved in the planning and production of films; utilization of rights, including video streaming; management of cinema complexes; and other video production, art production, and advertising activities. It also engages in the development, production, and rights management of TOHO animation titles, as well as licensing operations for Godzilla; production and exhibition of theatrical plays; and management of entertainment production…
